simple.summary: אֲצַלְיָהוּ (ʼĂtsalyâhûw) means Atsaljah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Chr 34 8.

definitions.full: H683. Atsalyahu אֲצַלְיָ֫הוּ proper name, masculine ( Yahweh hath reserved , or set apart ) father of Shaphan the scribe 2Kin 22:3 ; 2Chr 34:8 . אצם (meaning dubious, compare Arabic be angry ).
definitions.rootNote: from 680 and 3050 prolonged; Jah has reserved;
